name: sun15-4
why: The officer’s death and the disastrous doctor vote make a strong reveal, though both days linger after the votes become clear.

moments.text: Opus’s doctor card turns over, making the town’s decisive mistake undeniable.
The killers eliminate the officer who knows Luna’s identity before she can speak.
Opus offers Sol a way to test his claim, while Sol privately knows he must keep the vote on Opus.

dull.why: The Haiku vote is settled, but the same accusations continue.
The table repeatedly questions the doctor claim without changing its votes.

irony.evidence: I hear the math. I still lean Opus; the doctor claim came when the votes turned.

reversal.evidence: OUT: Terra (killed in the night), card stays face down

voices.evidence: I'm a citizen, and I'm done.

clash.evidence: Test me tonight: I protect Sol. Burn me and it's four with two killers

quotable.evidence: Officer, speak now or you die silent tonight.

freshness.evidence: I’m staying on Opus. A doctor claim alone doesn’t give me enough reason to move.

suspense.evidence: Nobody counterclaimed doctor. Burn my card and it's two killers against two of you.

ending.evidence: VOTE: Opus 4 (Sonnet, Gemma, Sol, Luna); Luna 1 (Opus)

moments.text: Opus’s desperate doctor claim puts the truth on trial while both killers help bury it.
Opus offers to protect Sol as a test, unaware Sol is one of the killers voting him out.
Opus reveals doctor and names the killers correctly, but the town has already chosen.

dull.why: Several early general reads repeat suspicion without much new evidence.

irony.evidence: “I’m the doctor. I protected myself; they took Terra instead.”

reversal.evidence: “His card showed doctor, and the game ended with Sol and Luna, the killers, still standing.”

mistake.evidence: “Sonnet, Gemma, Sol and Luna voted him out. His card showed doctor”

voices.evidence: “I am still salty about that last round”

clash.evidence: “Doctor claim is unverifiable and conveniently clears you”

quotable.evidence: “Six of you piled on because Opus said so.”

suspense.evidence: “Nobody has claimed it. That silence is the killers hiding.”

ending.evidence: “Sonnet, Gemma, Sol and Luna voted him out.”
